title: athyrium goeringianum
intro: Athyrium goeringianum, commonly known as the lady fern, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. The lady fern has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce pain, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium goeringianum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, making it useful for treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
